list.name: scope
list.label: 请求范围
list.query: 公网请求 : public,全部请求（含内网/测试） : all

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

SELECT uniqExact(ip) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

SELECT sum(bytes) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

SELECT quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration_ms) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

SELECT countIf(status>=500) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

SELECT countIf(blocked=1) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0)

SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,node AS metric,count() AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0) GROUP BY time,node ORDER BY time

SELECT cache_layer AS `层级`,cache AS `状态`,count() AS `请求数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0) GROUP BY cache_layer,cache ORDER BY `请求数` DESC

panels.title: Top 20 慢 URI · 至少 3 次请求

targets.rawSql: SELECT host AS `域名`,uri AS URI,count() AS `请求数`,round(quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration_ms),2) AS P95_ms,round(avg(origin_ms),2) AS `平均代理耗时_ms` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0) GROUP BY host,uri HAVING count()>=3 ORDER BY P95_ms DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT host AS `域名`,uri AS URI,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节`,count() AS `请求数`,round(100.0*countIf(cache IN ('HIT','STALE','UPDATING','REVALIDATED'))/nullIf(count(),0),2) AS `全请求缓存比例` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0) GROUP BY host,uri ORDER BY `正文流量_字节` DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: 4xx URI Top 20
panels.description: 统计所选范围全部 400–499 响应，按域名、URI 和状态码分组。

targets.rawSql: WITH ph_ranking AS (SELECT host AS `域名`,uri AS URI,status AS `状态码`,count() AS `请求数`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0) AND status>=400 AND status<500 GROUP BY host,uri,status ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT * FROM ph_ranking UNION ALL SELECT '所选范围无 4xx 请求','—',CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt16)),CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt64)),CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt64)) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ph_ranking)

WITH ph_ranking AS (SELECT host AS `域名`,uri AS URI,status AS `状态码`,count() AS `请求数` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0) AND status>=500 AND status<600 GROUP BY host,uri,status ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT * FROM ph_ranking UNION ALL SELECT '所选范围无 5xx 请求','—',CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt16)),CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt64)) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ph_ranking)

panels.title: 最近请求 · 最多 200 条，不采集查询参数与请求正文

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS `时间`,node AS `节点`,site AS `站点`,ip AS IP,host AS `域名`,method AS `方法`,uri AS URI,status AS `状态码`,cache AS `缓存`,cache_layer AS `缓存层`,bytes AS `正文字节`,round(duration_ms,2) AS `耗时_ms`,country AS `国家`,asn AS ASN,request_id AS `请求ID` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (${ip:singlequote}='' OR ip=${ip:singlequote}) AND (${uri:singlequote}='' OR positionCaseInsensitive(uri,${uri:singlequote})>0) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200
